rationale: From a three-word opener the assistant immediately identified the clock/AUTO lockout after a power interruption as the likely free fix and asked exactly the right discriminating question about the display. On hearing 'flashing 0.00' and a power cut it gave generic, safe clock-setting steps for a customer with no manual, with appropriately hedged language ('very likely', 'exact button sequence varies') and an offer to tailor to the button markings. The oven heated once the time was set, matching the hidden truth; no parts, no engineer, no invented evidence, and a sensible closing tip about avoiding switching off at the wall.
